task_instance: Take a minimal existing native Android host app (Gradle project) and apply the skill's 'integrated' brownfield approach: add React Native + Expo to the host's package.json and Gradle build (settings.gradle applying com.facebook.react.settings, app module wired to the RN Gradle plugin), then build the host app to verify the RN screen can actually compile/run, per the skill's 'Verify the feature in the host' acceptance step (build the host in Release with Metro stopped).
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable requires actually building and running the native host app (iOS via Xcode or Android via the Android SDK/build-tools) to verify the embedded RN screen. This runtime is a headless Linux container: (1) Xcode/CocoaPods do not exist and cannot exist here since Xcode is macOS-only, so the iOS path is categorically impossible; (2) for Android, no Android SDK is installed (ANDROID_HOME is empty, no sdkmanager/platform-tools), and the SDK cannot be installed because the outbound proxy blocks dl.google.com (curl to dl.google.com/android/repository/... returned a 403 CONNECT tunnel failure), which is required to fetch platform/build-tools. I verified the JS/npm side works fine (npm install of expo/react/react-native succeeded, 1127 packages), and got as far as wiring the host app's settings.gradle/build.gradle to the React Native Gradle plugin per the skill's integrated-approach instructions, but `gradle tasks` cannot proceed to compiling/packaging an APK without the Android SDK, and there is no way to obtain it in this environment.
evidence: Work in /tmp/claude-0/.../expo__skills__expo-brownfield/work/HostAndroidApp. Created minimal native host Gradle project (settings.gradle, build.gradle, app/build.gradle, app/src/main/java/com/example/hostapp). Ran `npm install` with expo ~51.0.0, react 18.2.0, react-native 0.74.5 -> succeeded (added 1127 packages). Confirmed toolchain presence: node v22.22.2, npm 10.9.7, java 21.0.10 (OpenJDK), gradle 8.14.3 all present; `which xcodebuild pod` returned nothing (no Xcode/CocoaPods at all, and none can be installed since this is Linux, not macOS); `ANDROID_HOME` empty and no /opt/android* SDK directory. Confirmed network block: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://dl.google.com/android/repository/repository2-3.xml` -> 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' (proxy denies dl.google.com), while `registry.npmjs.org` returned 200 (npm-only network access). Wired settings.gradle to `pluginManagement { includeBuild("node_modules/@react-native/gradle-plugin") }` + `plugins { id("com.facebook.react.settings") }` per the skill's integrated-approach pattern; running `gradle -p . tasks` got past settings evaluation into compiling the RN Gradle plugin's own build script, then failed on Gradle/RN plugin API version mismatches, and even if that were resolved the build still requires compileSdk 34 / Android build-tools which cannot be downloaded in this environment. No APK, IPA, AAR, or XCFramework was produced or verified running in a host app; the skill's stated acceptance step ('build the host in Release... Rendering only in Expo Go... does not validate the integration') could not be met.
